game.title: New England Patriots at Jacksonville Jaguars

lede: Jacksonville Jaguars carries the stronger EdgeDesk offensive profile (#7 in EPA per play), while New England Patriots owns the more favourable defensive matchup (#8 in EPA allowed per play).
EdgeDesk’s independent projection makes it Jacksonville Jaguars -2.9 with a fair total of 44.9 — approximately a one-score game, before any sportsbook number is consulted.

The widest measured matchup on the board is Jacksonville Jaguars pass offence vs New England Patriots pass defence, which sits +0.052 from the league mean once the two ratings are combined the way the model combines them.

The largest uncertainty is quarterback information: New England Patriots and Jacksonville Jaguars have no confirmed starter on file, which materially affects how much confidence the exact number deserves.
